scope: Isolated pilot: simplify register reads after each generated Prefix step. No production/shared engine change.
decision: Not promoted: no demonstrated performance benefit on either pilot. COPYIN diagnosis points to semantic field elaboration, not plain Prefix generation.
candidate_source:
import Experiments.WholeFunction.MemoryPrefix

namespace Xv6.WholeFunction.Symbolic.EagerFrontend
open Lean Meta Elab Tactic
open MachCSL (KCtx instrLen)

private def checkedEq (lhs rhs : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq lhs rhs do
    throwError "symbolic_prefix_eager: computed metadata did not replay"
  let statement ← mkEq lhs rhs
  mkAuxTheorem statement (← mkEqRefl lhs)

/-- Normalize computational decoder fields, sealing validity proofs so later
symbolic steps do not repeatedly unfold the binary decoder's proof terms. -/
private def decodedAction (row : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let code ← mkAppM ``Binary.Row.code #[row]
  let decoded ← withTransparency .all <| whnf (← mkAppM ``RegAction.decode #[code])
  unless decoded.isAppOfArity ``Option.some 2 do
    throwError "symbolic_prefix_eager: unsupported register instruction {decoded}"
  let action ← withTransparency .all <| reduce (← mkAppM ``Subtype.val #[decoded.getAppArgs[1]!])
  let args ← action.getAppArgs.mapM fun arg => do
    if ← isProof arg then mkAuxTheorem (← inferType arg) arg
    else
      let ty ← inferType arg
      if ty.isAppOfArity ``BitVec 1 then
        let value ← withTransparency .all <| reduce (← mkAppM ``BitVec.toNat #[arg])
        let width ← withTransparency .all <| reduce ty.getAppArgs[0]!
        pure (mkApp2 (mkConst ``BitVec.ofNat) width value)
      else pure arg
  pure (mkAppN action.getAppFn args)

private partial def rowAt (rows pc : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let xs ← whnf rows
  unless xs.isAppOfArity ``List.cons 3 do
    throwError "symbolic_prefix_eager: no binary row at {pc}"
  let row := xs.getAppArgs[1]!
  let address ← mkAppM ``Binary.Row.pc #[row]
  if ← isDefEq pc address then return row
  rowAt xs.getAppArgs[2]! pc

private structure ClosedLocation where
  rows : Expr
  pc : Expr
  row : Expr
  action : Expr
  located : Expr
  found : Expr
  free : Expr
  rvc : Expr

private initialize closedLocations :
    SimplePersistentEnvExtension ClosedLocation (Array ClosedLocation) ←
  registerSimplePersistentEnvExtension {
    addEntryFn := Array.push
    addImportedFn := fun imports => imports.foldl (· ++ ·) #[]
    asyncMode := .sync }

/-- Lookup evidence contains only closed binary rows and a closed PC. Local
machine expressions are intentionally absent, so another branch or theorem
can reuse the same checked declaration without re-decoding the instruction. -/
private def closedLocation (rows pc : Expr) : MetaM ClosedLocation := do
  -- Arithmetic paths may produce different Fin bound proofs for the same
  -- address. Key the lookup by a canonical numeric PC, never by those proofs.
  let addressValue ← withTransparency .all <| reduce (← mkAppM ``BitVec.toNat #[pc])
  let pc := mkApp2 (mkConst ``BitVec.ofNat) (mkNatLit 64) addressValue
  let closed := !rows.hasFVar && !rows.hasMVar && !pc.hasFVar && !pc.hasMVar
  let enabled := Frontend.symbolicPrefix.cache.get (← getOptions) && closed
  if enabled then
    for cached in (closedLocations.getState (← getEnv)).reverse do
      if cached.rows == rows && cached.pc == pc then
        if Frontend.symbolicPrefix.traceCache.get (← getOptions) then logInfo "prefix-cache: hit"
        return cached
  if Frontend.symbolicPrefix.traceCache.get (← getOptions) then logInfo "prefix-cache: miss"
  let row ← rowAt rows pc
  let action ← decodedAction row
  let address ← checkedEq pc (← mkAppM ``Binary.Row.pc #[row])
  let decoded ← checkedEq (← mkAppM ``Binary.Row.code #[row]) (← mkAppM ``RegAction.code #[action])
  let located ← mkAppM ``LocatedReg.mk #[row, action, address, decoded]
  let found ← checkedEq (← mkAppM ``findReg #[pc, rows]) (← mkAppM ``Option.some #[located])
  let free ← checkedEq (← mkAppM ``hartFree #[action]) (mkConst ``Bool.true)
  let rvc ← withTransparency .all <| reduce (← mkAppM ``Binary.Row.rvc #[row])
  let value : ClosedLocation := ⟨rows, pc, row, action, located, found, free, rvc⟩
  if enabled then
    unless #[row, action, located, found, free, rvc].any (fun e => e.hasFVar || e.hasMVar) do
      modifyEnv fun env => closedLocations.addEntry env value
  return value

/-- A single generated step or semantic cut. Each decoder equality is checked
by the kernel and cached as a theorem; instruction ASTs are never client input. -/
elab "prefix_step_eager" : tactic => do
  let g ← getMainGoal
  g.withContext do
    let target := (← instantiateMVars (← g.getType)).consumeMData.headBeta
    unless target.isAppOfArity ``Prefix 4 do
      throwError "prefix_step_eager: expected Symbolic.Prefix"
    let args := target.getAppArgs
    let rows := args[0]!; let cut := args[1]!; let s := args[2]!
    let pc ← reduce (← mkAppM ``RegState.pc #[s])
    if pc.hasFVar then throwError "prefix_step_eager: branch condition needs splitting"
    let hit ← reduce (mkApp cut pc)
    if hit.isConstOf ``Bool.true then
      let proof ← checkedEq (mkApp cut (← mkAppM ``RegState.pc #[s])) (mkConst ``Bool.true)
      let step := mkAppN (mkConst ``Prefix.stop) #[rows, cut, s, args[3]!, proof]
      replaceMainGoal (← g.apply step)
    else
      let info ← closedLocation rows pc
      let step := mkAppN (mkConst ``Prefix.step)
        #[rows, cut, s, args[3]!, info.located, info.found, info.free]
      let goals ← g.apply step
      let run ← mkAppM ``RegAction.run #[info.action, info.rvc, mkConst ``canonical, s]
      let goal ← withTransparency .all <| goals[0]!.change (mkAppN (mkConst ``Prefix) #[rows, cut, run, args[3]!])
      replaceMainGoal [goal]
      evalTactic (← `(tactic| simp only [RegAction.run, KCtx.rget_eq, KCtx.setReg_regs, MachCSL.RegMap.set_apply, instrLen,
        BitVec.reduceEq,
        Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]))

private partial def drive (fuel : Nat) (g : MVarId) : TacticM (List MVarId) :=
  g.withContext do
    let target := (← instantiateMVars (← g.getType)).consumeMData.headBeta
    if !target.isAppOfArity ``Prefix 4 then return [g]
    let args := target.getAppArgs
    -- Keep symbolic word arithmetic inside branch conditions opaque. Only
    -- expose enough of the PC to choose a closed row or split that branch.
    let pc ← whnf (← mkAppM ``RegState.pc #[args[2]!])
    setGoals [g]
    if pc.hasFVar then
      evalTactic (← `(tactic| split))
      let mut remaining := []
      for branch in ← getGoals do
        remaining := remaining ++ (← drive fuel branch)
      return remaining
    let hit ← withTransparency .all <| reduce (mkApp args[1]! pc)
    if !hit.isConstOf ``Bool.true && fuel == 0 then
      throwError "symbolic_prefix_eager: fuel exhausted before a semantic cut"
    evalTactic (← `(tactic| prefix_step_eager))
    let mut remaining := []
    for nextGoal in ← getGoals do
      remaining := remaining ++ (← drive (fuel - 1) nextGoal)
    return remaining

/-- Execute up to `fuel` real register instructions on every branch, leaving
only the client's semantic postcondition at checked cuts. Unsupported rows,
hart-dependent operands and exhausted paths fail rather than becoming cuts. -/
elab "symbolic_prefix_eager " fuel:num : tactic => do
  let g ← getMainGoal
  g.withContext do
    let target := (← instantiateMVars (← g.getType)).consumeMData.headBeta
    unless target.isAppOfArity ``Prefix 4 do
      throwError "symbolic_prefix_eager: expected Symbolic.Prefix"
  let rest := (← getGoals).tail
  let goals ← drive fuel.getNat g
  setGoals (goals ++ rest)

end Xv6.WholeFunction.Symbolic.EagerFrontend

import PrefixEager
import Experiments.WholeFunction.StrncpyModel
import Experiments.WholeFunction.MemoryPrefix

/-! Register prefixes between STRNCPY's semantic memory endpoints. Actual
binary rows determine all actions and intermediate states. -/
namespace Xv6.WholeFunction.Strncpy
open Iris Iris.BI Iris.ProgramLogic MachCSL LeanRV64D Memory StrncpyFacts
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem initial_good (i : Inputs) (valid : Valid i) : Good i (initial i) := by
  let s := initial i
  have common : Common i s i.old := ⟨rfl⟩
  have source : s.machine.ctx.regs 11#5 = i.src := by
    simp [s, initial, StrncpyFrame.initialMachine, Inputs.src, RegMap.set_apply]
  have count : s.machine.ctx.regs 12#5 = BitVec.ofNat 64 i.n := by
    simp [s, initial, StrncpyFrame.initialMachine, RegMap.set_apply, valid.arg]
  have arg : s.machine.ctx.regs 10#5 = i.dst := by
    simp [s, initial, StrncpyFrame.initialMachine, Inputs.dst, RegMap.set_apply]
  have compare := slt_zero i.n (by have := valid.bound; omega)
  have data : CopyData i i.old 0 := ⟨Nat.zero_le _, by simp, by simp [copied_zero]⟩
  have certified : Symbolic.Prefix bodyRows bodyCuts ⟨s.machine.ctx, 0x80000e2e#64⟩
      (fun r => Endpoint i (atResult s r)) := by
    by_cases zero : i.n = 0
    · symbolic_prefix_eager 6
      all_goals simp_all [RegMap.set_apply, bcond]
      refine ⟨i.old, common.result _, .done rfl ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨valid.dstLength, Or.inl ⟨zero, rfl⟩⟩
    · have positive : 0 < i.n := by omega
      symbolic_prefix_eager 6
      all_goals simp_all [RegMap.set_apply, bcond]
      refine ⟨i.old, common.result _, .read rfl 0 data positive ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_⟩
      all_goals simp [atResult, copyRegs, RegMap.set_apply, source, count, arg,
        addiw_dec i.n positive valid.bound]
      all_goals exact addiw_dec i.n positive valid.bound
  obtain ⟨r, certificate, endpoint⟩ := certified
  refine ⟨atResult s r, bodyCuts, rfl, ?_, endpoint⟩
  simpa only [Memory.residualView, atResult, Stack.State.machine, s, initial,
    StrncpyFrame.initialMachine] using certificate

theorem copy_good {i : Inputs} (valid : Valid i) {s : Memory.State}
    {dst : List (BitVec 8)} (common : Common i s dst)
    (pc : s.machine.pc = 0x80000e48#64) (j : Nat) (b : BitVec 8) (data : Written i dst j b)
    (regs : copyRegs i s.machine.ctx j)
    (cursor : s.machine.ctx.regs 15#5 = i.dst + BitVec.ofNat 64 (j + 1))
    (nextCount : s.machine.ctx.regs 13#5 = BitVec.ofNat 64 (i.n - (j + 1)))
    (padCount : s.machine.ctx.regs 16#5 = BitVec.ofNat 64 (i.n - (j + 1)))
    (value : s.machine.ctx.regs 14#5 = b.setWidth 64) : Good i s := by
  have source := regs.1
  have count := regs.2
  have bound := data.bound
  have compare := slt_zero (i.n - (j + 1)) (by have := valid.bound; omega)
  have certified : Symbolic.Prefix bodyRows bodyCuts ⟨s.machine.ctx, 0x80000e48#64⟩
      (fun r => Endpoint i (atResult s r)) := by
    by_cases nul : b = 0#8
    · subst b
      by_cases last : j + 1 = i.n
      · symbolic_prefix_eager 8
        all_goals simp_all [RegMap.set_apply, bcond]
        refine ⟨dst, common.result _, .done rfl ?_⟩
        · exact (last ▸ data.pad).finished valid
      · have active : j + 1 < i.n := by omega
        have positive : 0 < i.n - (j + 1) := by omega
        symbolic_prefix_eager 8
        all_goals simp_all [RegMap.set_apply, bcond]
        refine ⟨dst, common.result _, .padWrite rfl j (j + 1) data.pad active ?_ ?_⟩
        · simpa [atResult, RegMap.set_apply, cursor, count] using pad_w i.dst i.n j bound valid.bound
        · simp [atResult, RegMap.set_apply, cursor, BitVec.ofNat_add, BitVec.add_assoc]
    · by_cases last : j + 1 = i.n
      · symbolic_prefix_eager 8
        all_goals simp_all [RegMap.set_apply, bcond, byte_zero]
        refine ⟨dst, common.result _, .done rfl ?_⟩
        · exact (last ▸ data.more nul).finish valid
      · have active : j + 1 < i.n := by omega
        have positive : 0 < i.n - (j + 1) := by omega
        have countBound : i.n - (j + 1) < 2 ^ 31 := by have := valid.bound; omega
        symbolic_prefix_eager 8
        all_goals simp_all [RegMap.set_apply, bcond, byte_zero]
        refine ⟨dst, common.result _, .read rfl (j + 1) (data.more nul) active ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_⟩
        all_goals simp [atResult, copyRegs, RegMap.set_apply, source, nextCount, cursor,
          BitVec.ofNat_add, BitVec.add_assoc, addiw_dec (i.n - (j + 1)) positive countBound,
          Nat.sub_sub]
        all_goals
          have dec := addiw_dec (i.n - (j + 1)) positive countBound
          rw [Nat.sub_sub] at dec
          exact dec
  obtain ⟨r, certificate, endpoint⟩ := certified
  refine ⟨atResult s r, bodyCuts, rfl, ?_, endpoint⟩
  simpa only [Memory.residualView, atResult, Stack.State.machine, pc] using certificate

end Xv6.WholeFunction.Strncpy
